subtitle.zh: Local unlimited-length talking video: a portrait (or a source video) + one voice track -> lip-synced mp4 (InfiniteTalk on Wan2.1 I2V 14B fp8, ComfyUI native nodes).
subtitle.en: Local unlimited-length talking video: a portrait (or a source video) + one voice track -> lip-synced mp4 (InfiniteTalk on Wan2.1 I2V 14B fp8, ComfyUI native nodes).

notes.zh: MTNode runs an isolated ComfyUI (127.0.0.1:8199) with ComfyUI's native WanInfiniteTalkToVideo node. The infinitetalk_gen canvas node takes an image (I2V) or a source video (V2V) plus audio and returns an mp4; audio longer than one 81-frame window is chunked by the host (next chunk is conditioned on the previous frames) and muxed back with the original track.
notes.en: MTNode runs an isolated ComfyUI (127.0.0.1:8199) with ComfyUI's native WanInfiniteTalkToVideo node. The infinitetalk_gen node takes an image (I2V) or a source video (V2V) plus audio and returns an mp4; audio longer than one 81-frame window is chunked by the host (next chunk conditioned on the previous frames) and muxed back with the original track.
